notes.title: Demo is live!
notes.content:
It is finally time for Sunny Grove's demo to launch and it is now available to everyone.

The demo includes the following:

3 different levels. (Plus the tutorial)
A variety of enemies who will stand in your way.
Different methods for crossing the lands as you travel (Geysers, ice skating etc)
Collectables, secret paths and treasures!


We would love to hear your feedback on the demo. We want to create an enjoyable experience as you help Penny search for her little ones.
Be sure to put on your explorer hats so you don't miss the secret treasures around the levels.

You can also join our discord if you want to chat with us directly.
https://discord.gg/ypvYEQrmvk
